factor_name: Volatility-scaled medium-term cross-asset reversal (60d formation, 10d skip)

calculation.description: Ranks assets by negative 60-session return ending 10 sessions before decision, scaled by trailing 20-session realized volatility. All inputs are lagged and available before the decision. Positive values indicate stronger expected forward performance.

validation.regime_notes: No qualifying observations before 2025 because the 20-session volatility window and complete cross-sectional alignment leave insufficient valid data in the available artifact universe; strong 2025-2026 and 2027 results require conservative interpretation. Small 15-instrument universe.
